component.name: GitHub ReDesktop
component.summary: Collaborate on GitHub from your Linux desktop

description.p: GitHub ReDesktop is a native rewrite of GitHub Desktop for Linux, built in Rust with the COSMIC toolkit. It is fast, light and integrates with your desktop theme.

ul.li: Review your changes with a clear, colored diff and pick the files to commit
Create, switch, rename, merge and delete branches
Fetch, pull, push and publish repositories to GitHub in one click
Browse the history, revert, cherry-pick or undo commits
Clone any of your GitHub repositories, stash changes and more
